name: Bloodpetal Zapper
label: Quest
description: Bloodpetal Zapper: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: For the zapper to work, it needs a sample of the target creature. Head out into the crater and collect a Bloodpetal sprout. Then I can calibrate it to work on Muigin's little friends...
If he weren't so stubborn, we could be on our way home, already... But until then, I'll just have to show him that his little prank doesn't bother me at all!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Looks like this is going to work perfectly, friend. Now remember, if you see any of those pests around, don't hesitate to use that zapper!
